items.summary: Port NanoVDB volume spatial field to HIP. Vendored external/nanovdb provides only a CUDA DeviceBuffer (util/cuda/CudaDeviceBuffer.h) and NanoVDBField.cpp is CUDA-only; upstream excludes VDB from HIP (message WARNING No VDB support with HIP). Resume: add a hip-backed nanovdb DeviceBuffer shim + a WITH_HIP arm in NanoVDBField.cpp, add NanoVDBField.hip to the _hip target, drop the warning. Non-VDB spatial fields (structured/unstructured/AMR) are ported in the main port.

visionaray master include/visionaray/detail/bvh/hip_bvh.h (hip::lbvh_builder, added in 38d88eb7 'Refactor lbvh builders into separate namespaces') declares assign_indices(cuda_index_bvh

&) and assign_indices(cuda_bvh

&), copied from cuda_lbvh.h; under hipcc those names do not exist, so any TU including the header fails ('no template named cuda_index_bvh'). Nothing inside visionaray includes it, so its CI never compiles it. anari-visionaray main (moat-fix-10) includes it for the HIP device, so the HIP device cannot build against unpatched visionaray master. Fix: change the two parameter types to hip_index_bvh

& / hip_bvh

& (2 lines). Needs a visionaray change upstream (szellmann/visionaray), which is a person's call: the visionaray port's PR is merged, so this would be a follow-up round on that project.

HIP device cannot target gfx942/gfx950 (MI300 class): ROCm disables the image/texture API on gfx94x at compile time (__HIP_NO_IMAGE_SUPPORT via __gfx94plus_clr__) and at runtime (hipDeviceAttributeImageSupport=0, hipMalloc3DArray -> operation not supported). visionaray's hip_texture (tex1D/tex2D/tex3D) is used in device code for transfer functions, structured volumes, HDRI and image samplers, so 8 HIP TUs fail at 6f1e7937 on gfx942. Supporting it means a buffer-backed texture path with software filtering under __HIP_NO_IMAGE_SUPPORT in visionaray (and any direct texture use here): a feature-sized change, not a port fix. Pre-existing since the original port; not caused by fix round moat-fix-10.

AMD clang 24.0.0git (ROCm 10.1): in a leaf device function large enough to need long branches, AMDGPU branch relaxation expands them through s[30:31] (the return address) without saving it, so s_setpc_b64 s[30:31] at return jumps back into the function and the kernel never finishes. Seen for gfx1201 sampleLight in the raycast renderer (worked around by forcing it inline on HIP) and still present, unexercised, in basic_intersector<ISOSurface>::operator() on gfx1201; standalone reproducer miscompiles on gfx90a, gfx942, gfx1030, gfx1100, gfx1151, gfx1200, gfx1201. Reproducer and draft issue in notes.md.
